method:
Rendered every page of both booklets with music_pages.py render at 110 dpi (listening 1-16, composing 1-16) and read every ask page in full; confirmed on contact sheets that listening 1, 7, 12-16 and composing 1, 2, 12-16 carry no question text (covers, BLANK PAGE, ROUGH WORK lines and staves), matching the file's pagesWithoutAsks. Dumped every text-layer span with its font (PyMuPDF) on listening 2-6, 8-11 and composing 3-11, and zoomed with PyMuPDF clips at 300-500 dpi on: the en dashes in "Bars 1–8" (listening p2 heading, p10 bullet), "bars 1–8" (p3 Excerpt 1(ii), p10 bullet and Bars 9–16(i)), "bars 1–11" (p5 bullet), "bars 9–16" (p10 bullet); the em dashes in composing Q4's cadence lines "(I—ii—V)", "(IV—V—I)", "(IV—V—vi)", "(vi—IV—I)" (p7, zoomed at 500 dpi: long dashes, text layer U+2014); the curly apostrophes (U+2019) in "’Twas" and "thro’" (composing p4 poem); the hyphens in eight-bar, mid-time, non-traditional and Rimsky-Korsakov; "key note" (two words, Q2) against "keynote" (Q1, Q3); "J.S. Bach.", "W.A. Mozart.", "No.1" (no space) and "3rd" (on the baseline, no superscript); the closing stops: "Seele." (Q1 Excerpt 3(iii), upright stop after the italic title), "Piano Quartet No.1." (Q2(v)), none after "Bohemian Rhapsody" (Q4(v)), none after "Q. 5 Irish Music", none after the bare "Excerpt 1/2/3" headings of Q5, none after the Section B stem "... Q4 or Q5 or Q6", and the stops after "Q3." and "two sections." in the Section A stem; Q3(v) "p" and "mf" (Opus music-font dynamics in print; the 2011-ol-008 OCR reads "Explain the markings p and mf as they appear on the score above.", so the line is proven without readFromPage); "PREPARATORY WORK" (regular capitals, not bold, no bullet) on composing p6, p8, p10. Bullets checked on the render: listening Q1-Q6 lead-ins, the Q6 Excerpt 1 heading bullets, the restart bullet "The next 8 bars (bars 9–16) will now be played THREE times." and "The excerpt will be played once more. Answer (iv) below." print bullets; Q5's lead-in sentence prints none, its "Answer the questions on each excerpt." one; composing bullets as printed, none on titles, "In the case of both (a) and (b),", "Answer (a) and (b).", "Study this opening ...", the poem, PREPARATORY WORK or the "(i) At A, ..." lines. Typed the printed text of every in-scope field into a script (lead-in bullets "
• ", composing bullets " • ", tick boxes "□ ", unbulleted lines joined with a space, "
" between stems either side of option rows and before each Q1 Excerpt 3(iii) / Q4(v) answer heading) and compared every file string exactly, no normalisation: 135 of 135 identical. Then checked all 3,514 word tokens of the file strings, case and punctuation included, against the booklet text layers (fi/fl ligatures expanded): every token found. Listed the code point of every non-ASCII character in the file strings and addresses: • U+2022, – U+2013, — U+2014, ’ U+2019, □ U+25A1 only (no ligature characters, no straight apostrophes, no hyphen where an en dash is printed). The file has no readFromPage entries. Every address matches the printed numbering: Q1, Q5 and Q6 number their parts afresh under each excerpt; Q6 Excerpt 1 restarts (i)-(iii) under the printed bars bullet ("Q6 Excerpt 1 Bars 9–16(i)", U+2013); composing Section A Q1(a)/(b), Q2 (one ask, no (a)/(b) printed), Q3(a)/(b), Section B Q4-Q6; 45 listening + 8 composing = 53 asks, the file's count. Observations, not text differences: (1) Q1 Excerpt 3(iii) has excerptLine null by design (its note: set-work knowledge about the whole cantata), so it has no excerptLine entry; the Excerpt 3 heading is carried by Excerpt 3(i)/(ii). (2) Section A Q1(a)/(b) join the tick-box list with "
", Q3(a)/(b) with a space; both are permitted joiners. (3) The page-2 scores of Q1 (Excerpt 1 vocal line bars 1–8 with underlay, Excerpt 3 outline score) are in no ask's figure (every Q1 figure is a page-3 crop); outside the text check, noted for the lane lead. (4) Composing p11 (Q6) prints no A/B/C/D letters over the score, only the chord boxes, although the bullet reads "at A, B, C and D"; the string is as printed.
